captions.instagram:
There's a 6-digit code that stops anyone else from filing a tax return with your Social Security number.

✔️ It's the IRS Identity Protection PIN (IP PIN). Anyone with an SSN or ITIN who can verify their identity can get one, even if you don't have to file.
✔️ Get it in the IRS app or your IRS online account. A new one is issued every year.
✔️ The online tool goes down for maintenance in mid-November and is back in mid-January. Filing early in 2027? Request yours now.
✔️ The IRS will never call, email, text or message you on social media to ask for your IP PIN.

Source: IRS, IR-2026-127 and Get an Identity Protection PIN.
